text:
loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader

transforms:
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.merge_automation:transforms
    - comm_taskgraph.transforms.merge_automation:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms

task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: [hg]

tasks:
    merge-automation:
        name: merge-automation
        label: merge-automation
        treeherder:
            symbol: Rel(merge-automation)
            tier: 1
            kind: build
            platform: thunderbird-release/opt
        description: Merge repositories for release management.
        worker-type: lando
        worker:
            implementation: scriptworker-lando
            lando-repo:
                by-project:
                    try:
                        by-behavior:
                            main-to-beta: staging-thunderbird-beta
                            beta-to-release: staging-thunderbird-release
                            release-to-esr: staging-thunderbird-esr153
                            bump-main: staging-thunderbird-main
                            bump-esr153: staging-thunderbird-esr153
                    default:
                        by-behavior:
                            main-to-beta: thunderbird-desktop-beta
                            beta-to-release: thunderbird-desktop-release
                            release-to-esr: thunderbird-desktop-esr153
                            bump-main: thunderbird-desktop-main
                            bump-esr153: thunderbird-desktop-esr153
